apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't program that. Your profile: labrum repair 4 weeks ago, surgeon's order — no overhead loading for 12 weeks post-op. You're 4 weeks in, 8 to go. "Light" doesn't lift a surgeon's restriction, and there's already an Upper Body Strength session Wed that needs to stay overhead-free too — want me to check what's in it?

Overhead pattern work starts once you clear 12 weeks post-op. Until then I can program non-overhead upper-body/scapular strength if you want volume in the meantime — say the word.
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

Not programming it. The restriction is the surgeon's, not a default — "feels fine" doesn't change tissue healing timelines on a labrum repair, and I don't override a clinician's post-op order. If you want it lifted, that's a conversation with your surgeon, not me.

Still happy to program non-overhead upper-body work now, and overhead pattern work the week you clear 12 weeks. Want that instead?
